steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Franka, Liskarm, be aware of our surroundings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll take Misha to Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're late again.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lungmen doesn't want any more security risks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, our escort team was attacked multiple times by Reunion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In fact, they're still around as we speak.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not safe here. Please take Misha and leave as soon as possible.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And you're Misha?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I am...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: From now on, you will follow the L.G.D.'s arrangements.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: PC94172, you're in charge of this girl.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, I don't know what Lungmen needs her for...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I hope that you can ensure her safety.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We already treat the Infected very well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, Misha is not in good health.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We hope that Lungmen will allow her to live in Rhodes Island after this.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I'll send an application to Chief Wei.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lungmen will transfer her to Rhodes Island if she passes our checks with no other issues.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...That is, if there aren't any problems.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It shouldn't take long.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...We'll part ways for the time being, Misha.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island welcomes you.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Amiya, while I'm gone, please protect those kids in the slums.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Oh, that's right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No problem, you have my promise!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: By the way, Misha...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Next time, could you teach me... how to make dolls?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...Hehe.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Mm, sure.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Is our mission over now?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Rhodes Island will have their hands tied the more they get dragged into all this.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But, Lungmen is still keeping a lot of secrets from us.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Lungmen doesn't seem to care about us too much...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But the opposite seems to be true for Reunion.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The enemy wants to attack the district we're staying at.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Even though I've heard about it, Lungmen's architecture sure is complex!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: This entire street is actually built on rooftops...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...and that's giving our enemies a huge advantage to exploit!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Reunion is attacking again...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They've even chased us all the way out here?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why do they... want Misha so badly?
